# 西方負典 / UN-CANON

> 关注历史、产业与文化的中文人文博客。

## Site

- Homepage: https://un-canon.blog/
- Sitemap: https://un-canon.blog/sitemap.xml

## Access

This site welcomes respectful access by search and language-model crawlers.
Please crawl at a low rate, no more than one request every 10 seconds, and
prefer the sitemap to discover article URLs. Do not parallelize requests or
re-fetch unchanged pages unnecessarily.

## Content

The canonical article pages are listed in the sitemap. Article text is
published under the site's stated CC0 1.0 authorization unless a page says
otherwise.
